strings.(어디선가 불어오는 바람을 따라 도착한 곳은 아드리카. 그 앞에는 미뉴에: (Following a wind from somewhere far away, the adventurer arrives in Adrica. Minuet stands ahead with a vacant expression.)
strings.(아무리 불러도 미뉴에트가 대답하지 않는다.): (No matter how often the adventurer calls, Minuet gives no answer.)
strings.(갑자기 시야가 검은 색으로 가득 채워진다.): (The adventurer's vision suddenly fills with black.)
strings.(처음 보는 낯선 장소에서 누군가의 고통소리가 울려퍼진다.): (Cries of pain echo through an unfamiliar place.)
strings.1. 누구지? 누구의 목소리지?: 1. Who is that? Whose voice is it?
strings.(조금씩 고통을 호소하는 자의 모습이 어둠 속에서 보이기 시작한다.): (The suffering figure slowly becomes visible in the darkness.)
strings.(머리에 검은 뿔이 달려 있다. 혹시 악마?): (Black horns on his head. Could he be a demon?)
strings.인간놈들이 가지고 있는 마석으로는 안 된다!!: The magic stones those humans have aren't enough!
strings.저 악마는 내가 보이지 않는 거야? 나는 왜 볼 수 있는 거지?: Can that demon not see me? Why can I see him?
Magic stones... A ▒▒ made from magic stones... I have to find it...
strings.(검을 뿔을 가진 소년의 앞에 검고 푸른 마석이 잔뜩 있다.): (Black and blue magic stones lie piled before the black-horned boy.)
Magic stones made by the Deimos cult...
strings.(다시 시야가 흐려져 더 이상 악마의 모습이 보이지 않는다.): (The adventurer's vision blurs again, and the demon can no longer be seen.)
Oh, I'm still Minuet. Please wait a moment.
strings.아, 혹시 가이아 님?: Oh, is that you, Lady Gaia?
strings.(미뉴에트의 주위에서 신성한 빛이 올라오기 시작한다.): (A sacred light begins to rise around Minuet.)
strings.(그때와 같네. 가이아 님으로 변하던….): (Just like before, when she turned into Lady Gaia...)
Ah, I think it will work now...
strings.(신성한 빛이 다시 한번 올라오더니 미뉴에트가 여신 가이아의 모습으로 변: (The sacred light rises again, and Minuet takes the form of the goddess Gaia.)
I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
It seems I am long overdue for sleep, yet I still cannot rest.
strings.방금 제가 본 게 뭔지 아시나요?: Do you know what I just saw?
strings.혹시 방금 뭔가 보신 건가요?: Did you see something just now?
strings.(어둠 속에서 어떤 악마 소년이 데이모스 교단의 마석을 잔뜩 가진 걸 봤: (The adventurer describes seeing a demon boy in the darkness with a great many magic stones from the Deimos cult.)
strings.마계의 영역을 보고 오신 것 같은데…. 그건 어쩌면 유물의 영향일지도 모: It sounds as though you saw a region of the Demon Realm... Perhaps that was the relic's influence.
The Flame of Truth that Lethe possessed...
Perhaps Lethe wanted to tell you something.
strings.레테…, 레테는 소멸한 건가요?: Lethe... Has she ceased to exist?
You may meet her again when the time comes.
I suppose that's a relief... I had so much I wanted to ask her.
Oh, Lady Gaia. Could you tell me now why you called for me?
strings.당신과 이리스에게 필요한 초인의 힘, 이제 남은 것은 셋. 한 번의 흔적: The Champions' power that you and Iris need... Three remain now. A trace of one... You will find it by traveling north beyond Adrica.
strings.아드키나와 메디아가 봉인했던 길은 제 요청으로 풀려 이제 가실 수 있어요: At my request, Atkina and Medea have unsealed the path they closed. You may travel through it now.
strings.그리고 가기 전에 아드키나를 만나보세요. 도움을 줄 이야기를 해줄 거예요: Before you go, speak with Atkina. He will tell you something that should help.
I will be going, then. Until we meet again.
strings.(신성한 빛이 가이아를 스쳐 가면서 다시 미뉴에트의 모습이 보인다.): (Sacred light passes over Gaia, revealing Minuet once more.)
Yes... Oh, I felt sleepy for a moment...
strings.안 그래도 가이아 님께서 틈나는 대로 자두라고 하셔서…. 저 잠깐 잘게요: Lady Gaia told me to sleep whenever I could... I'll take a little nap.
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 미뉴에트가 선 채로 잠이 든다.): (No sooner has Minuet spoken than she falls asleep standing up.)
She looks so peaceful... It's enough to make me want a nap, too...
strings.흐음, 그러면 나는 아드키나 님에게 가자. 가면 무슨 일인지 알겠지?: Hmm. Then I'll go see Lord Atkina. I should find out what's happening there.
It's been a while, Lord Atkina.
strings.가이아 님께서 아드키나 님이 절 도와줄 사람에 관해 이야기해주신다 그래서: Lady Gaia said you would tell me about someone who could help me, so I came to see you.
strings.얼마 전, 포보스에 악마들이 많이 나타났네. 별 일은 없지만, 그래도 사: Recently, many demons appeared in Phobos. Nothing serious happened, but I set up a simple barrier to protect the settlements and spirit beasts.
strings.포보스 쪽은 그가 잘 알고 있어서 미리 말해뒀네. 여신의 심부름꾼이 곧: He knows Phobos well, so I told him in advance that the goddess's messenger would be arriving soon.
strings.벨레드라고 하네. 포보스에 나타난 악마나 몬스터와 싸우고 있을 거야. 그: His name is Veled. He should be fighting the demons and monsters in Phobos. Speak with him and find what needs doing, and you should be able to meet the Fierce King as well.
Valdrick always appears in Phobos around this time.
I would like to help you myself, but there is work I must attend to in Adrica. I'm sorry.
It's all right. I'll head to Phobos, then.
Please, don't judge Veled harshly when you see him.
strings.(나쁘게 몰고 가지 말란 말씀은 뭘까? 나중에 생각하고, 일단 포보스로: (What does he mean, don't judge him harshly? I'll think about it later. For now, to Phobos.)
strings.(%s의 모습이 용의 계곡에서 사라지고 어디선가 꽃잎을 실은 바람이 불어: (As %s leaves Dragon Valley, a breeze carrying flower petals blows in from somewhere.)
strings.(따스한 바람이 지나간 자리에 가이아가 나타난다.): (Gaia appears where the warm breeze has passed.)
Forgive me, Lady Gaia. What happened last time...
It wasn't your fault, Atkina. Don't trouble yourself over it. The fault lies with those who invaded this place.
Are you all right, Lady Gaia? And Lady Iris...
I'm sorry you had to endure something you never wanted.
I'm all right. I was only worried about you... Ah...
strings.(가이아가 아드키나에게 다가가 가슴에 얼굴을 묻는다.): (Gaia approaches Atkina and rests her face against his chest.)
Just as Seres did, I too will act for this land...
You lot never get tired of this, do you? I suppose that's what happens when you can't learn.
strings.(앳되어 보이는 소년이 씨익 웃으며 달려오는 악마와 몬스터를 향해 손을: (A youthful-looking boy grins and reaches toward the charging demons and monsters. Red light streams from his hand and envelops them.)
strings.(악마와 몬스터들의 눈빛이 변하더니 서로를 공격하기 시작한다.): (The demons' and monsters' eyes change, and they begin attacking each other.)
I know you're there. Stop watching and come out.
strings.네가 나타나서 저놈들이 나한테 온 거 알아. 본능밖에 없는 녀석들은 늘: I know they came at me because you showed up. Creatures ruled by instinct always react to power. And I don't mean ordinary power. Special power...
strings.그러고보니 너, 아드키나 아저씨가 보낸 사람이야?: Come to think of it, are you the person old Atkina sent?
strings.(벨레드라고 불린 소년이 씨익 웃으며 악수를 청한다.): (The boy called Veled grins and offers a handshake.)
It's nice to meet you. I'm %s...
I'm Veled. I've heard about you. The old fellow asked me to help.
strings.(…손 끝에서 알 수 없는 힘이 느껴져….): (...I can feel a strange power through his fingertips...)
strings.역시 너 보통 인간과는 다르구나. 그냥 인간들은 알아서 매료된 채로 오던: You really are different from ordinary humans. Most just come to me in a trance...
strings.나는 악마지만 다른 거에 관심없으니 너무 걱정하지 마. 관심 있는 건 딱: I'm a demon, but I'm not interested in anything else, so don't worry. There's only one thing I care about.
I thought something was different about you, but a demon...
I'm not an ordinary demon. I'd appreciate it if you didn't compare me to those idiots.
strings.널 도와주는 것도 도와주는 건데 말이지. 내가 네 실력이 어떤지도 모르잖: I do want to help you, but I don't even know what you can do. So...
strings.확실한 걸 보여줘야겠어. 저기 보이는 멍청한 것들을 잡아봐. 네 힘이라면: You'll have to give me a clear demonstration. Take down those idiots over there. With your power, that shouldn't be a problem, right?
Every one we get rid of will help Peonia.
I'll wait here. Go on, then.
strings.나 이곳에 와서 너 같은 인간은 처음 봐. 날고 긴다는 해결사들을 보긴: You're the first human like this I've met since coming here. I've seen fixers who claimed to be the best, but...
Taking down this many demons and monsters... You really do deserve the name Executioner.
Then let me explain. It's nothing complicated. Lots of demons are appearing in Phobos.
I can see that for myself...
The trouble is, I don't know exactly where they're coming from. We need to find out.
strings.내가 의심스럽지? 괜찮아. 당연한 거야. 인간에게 악마나 이질적인 존재는: You don't trust me, do you? That's fine. It's only natural. To humans, demons and other strange beings are all suspicious.
strings.그래도 믿어주면 안 될까? 나 인간을 좋아해. 악마가 아닌 그냥 자아가: But could you trust me anyway? I like humans. As one being with a mind and a soul to another, beyond being a demon.
I get the feeling there's someone in particular, beyond humans in general...
Yes. Peonia. The person I love. You're going to Mars anyway, so you'll meet her soon enough.
Sigh... After all this, I wish Peonia would just trust me.
strings.(벨레드의 눈빛이 왠지 슬퍼 보인다.): (There is something sad in Veled's eyes.)
strings.피오니아를 위해 멍청한 악마들을 계속 잡고 있어. 그러다가 방법이 생기면: I keep hunting these stupid demons for Peonia. It would be nice if a solution turned up along the way...
strings.그런데 아드키나 님하고는 어떻게 알고 지내요?: How do you know Lord Atkina?
strings.그 아저씨는 좀 신기해. 내가 추방 당해 포보스와 아드리카 경계에 쓰러져: That old fellow is unusual. After I was banished, he rescued me when I collapsed on the border between Phobos and Adrica.
The truth is, I was so popular in Rosengarten that the other dream demons drove me out. Just look at this beauty!
I'd say you're more cute than beautiful... Oh! Sorry.
strings.뭐야? 내가 아름다워 보이지 않는 거야?: What? You don't think I'm beautiful?
strings.후우, 피오니아도 피오니아지만, 너도 귀여움과 아름다움을 제대로 구분할: Whew. First Peonia, now you. You both need an eye that can properly distinguish cuteness from beauty.
strings.내가 아름다움에 대해서 설명할게. 아, 아니다. 피오니아가 강제적으로 하: Let me explain beauty to you. Oh, no. Peonia said not to force things on people.
Thank you for telling me. I'll ask Peonia, then.
Thanks for listening. And sorry. I haven't really helped you at all...
Don't worry about it. It's fine.
strings.피오니아도 이야기를 들어주긴 하지만, 경계하고 있고. 기가 센 인간들은: Peonia listens, but she's still wary. Strong-willed humans try to kill me. Foolish ones fall under my charm and die...
I've just been through all kinds of things.
Right. You're definitely no ordinary person...
Hey, you two. Sorry to interrupt...
strings.(벨레드와 대화 중에 말을 건 쪽을 바라보니 불량해 보이는 모습의 남자가: (The adventurer turns toward the voice and sees a rough-looking man.)
strings.그렇다. 피오니아라는 빨간 머리 여자가 이쪽에 있는 빨간 뿔 악마한테 이: That's right. A red-haired woman called Peonia told me to ask the red-horned demon here. Said you'd know.
Oh, the target should be deeper in, over that way.
strings.(해결사라 불린 남자가 답을 듣자마자 사라진다.): (The man called a fixer leaves as soon as he gets his answer.)
strings.마르스에서 고용한 해결사야. 생각보다 몬스터와 악마들 숫자가 많거든. 여: A fixer hired by Mars. There are more monsters and demons than we expected, so they told them to ask me here.
strings.반 정도는 벌벌 떨거나 멋대로 나한테 안기거나 그렇긴 한데, 저 사람은: About half of them either shake with fear or throw themselves into my arms. That one was a little different.
strings.어쨌든 마르스로 가봐. 크리시엔과 피오니아한테 내 안부 전해줘. 크리시엔: Anyway, head to Mars. Give Crisien and Peonia my regards. You'll find Crisien as soon as you enter town.
And take care of any demons or monsters that get in your way.
strings.(포보스는 확실히 이상하네…. 저 해결사도 벨레드를 보고도 이상하게 생각: (Phobos really is strange... Even that fixer didn't find anything odd about Veled...)
strings.(아, 모르겠다. …가이아 님께서 날 보낸 목적이 있으니까, 일단 피오니: (Oh, I don't know. Lady Gaia sent me here for a reason, so I'll visit this Peonia first. I'm bound to learn something.)
strings.음, 기분 탓인가? 왜 자꾸 이상한 생각이 들지…? 나는…. 그나저나 저: Hmm. Is it my imagination? Why do these strange thoughts keep coming...? I... And that fixer bothers me, too...
Ugh, I'm sleepy... I should have gone to bed early. There's so much work...
strings.(졸린 눈을 한 붉은 머리 소녀가 벤치에 앉아 하품을 하고 있다. 바늘과: (A sleepy-eyed, red-haired girl yawns on a bench. Holding a needle, thread, and cloth, she tries to work, only to nod off again.)
Veled asked me to give his regards to you and Peonia.
strings.그래요? 벨레드가? 마르스에는 시장님이 못 오게 하니까 지나가는 사람에게: Really? Veled did? The mayor won't let him into Mars, so he must have asked someone passing by.
Hello? Why did you stop in the middle of...
Ah! Sorry... I nodded off for a moment.
You aren't ill, are you? I saw a doctor over there.
strings.흐아암. 죄송해요. 그정도까진 아니예요. 벨레드 옷도 언젠가 수선해야 할: Yaaawn. Sorry. It's nothing that serious. I need to mend Veled's clothes sometime, too... Hmm, but things aren't good enough for that yet...
Pio has so much work, too... But I haven't seen you before.
Oh, I came from another region on business.
strings.우와, 그러시군요. 나중에 저한테 오시면 옷 수선 해드릴게요. 괜찮은 옷: Wow, I see. Come back later and I'll mend your clothes. I'll make you some nice ones, too...
strings.아니에요! 피오 언니가 있을 곳을 생각했을 뿐이에요! 언니는 이쪽으로 쭉: I'm not! I was just thinking about where Pio might be! Keep going this way and you'll find her.
strings.그런데 해결사님은 인상이 좋으시네요. 대부분 여기 오는 사람들은 험악하던: You have a nice face for a fixer. Most people who come here look so scary. That man who passed by earlier frightened me, too.
Ugh, and it's noisy when Uncle Valdrick visits... The mayor's away, too.
The mayor's really wonderful, but we haven't seen him lately. Maybe he's away on business. It's been quite a while... That's why Pio is so busy.
Oh, is that so? Thank you, Crisien.
...I'd better not wake her. She looks exhausted...
Oh, but Valdrick? It seems the Fierce King really is nearby...
strings.일단, 피오니아 라는 사람에게 가보고 알아봐야겠다. 금방 만날 수 있을: I'll ask Peonia first. It feels like I'll meet him soon, but I still don't know...
strings.(마르스의 거리 안 쪽의 건물, 그 앞에서 빨간 머리의 한 여성이 사람들: (In front of a building deeper along the streets of Mars, a red-haired woman explains something to a group.)
strings.(설명을 들은 우락부락한 남자들이 알겠다며 포보스 쪽으로 발걸음을 옮긴다: (The burly men nod in understanding and head toward Phobos.)
strings.당신, 해결사지? 잘 왔어. 여기는 마르스 시티야. 나는 클라우스 시장님: You're a fixer, right? Welcome. This is Mars City. I'm Peonia, Mayor Klaus's secretary and steward.
strings.다른 곳에서는 포보스로 알려져 있지만, 포보스는 이 지역 전체를 부르는: People elsewhere call it Phobos, but Phobos is the name of this entire region.
strings.포보스라고 해도, 마르스라고 해도 상관없어. 어차피 여기 있는 사람들이: Call it Phobos or Mars, either is fine. It's the land everyone here loves, regardless.
strings.목적은 포보스에 있는 몬스터와 악마를 쓰러뜨리는 것. 쓰러뜨리는 숫자에: Your job is to defeat the monsters and demons in Phobos. You'll be paid according to how many you take down.
strings.당신이 세지 않아도 포보스에 있는 특별한 존재가 숫자를 셀 거야. 그만두: You don't need to keep count. A special being in Phobos will do that. Report to me when you want to quit or when your term ends.
I'll pay you according to your total. Write your name here and sign.
Excuse me. Could you listen for a moment?
strings.일단 서명부터 해. 이야기 들을 시간이 없어 그러니 양해해줘. 해결사들이: Sign first. I don't have time to talk, so please understand. Some fixers have left, which means the pay is pretty good. If you work hard, you can...
strings.(피오니아가 서명 증서에 적힌 %s의 이름을 보더니 고개를 갸웃거린다.): (Peonia tilts her head at the name %s on the signed document.)
Oh, Rosemary told me. You're a hero.
strings.아, 아니에요. 영웅 같은 건…. 그런데 로즈마리가 여기 있어요?: Oh, no. I'm no hero... But Rosemary is here?
strings.맘에 안드는 데미갓 잡으러 아발론까지 갔다 도망 왔다고 하더라고. 루맨에: She said she went all the way to Avalon to hunt down a Demigod she didn't like, then fled. She crossed the mountains from Lumen, apparently.
strings.정말 본받고 싶어. 저런 사람이 마르스에 몇 명 더 있었으면 좋았을 텐데: I'd love to follow her example. I wish Mars had a few more people like her.
strings.이런 이야기는 못 들은 거로 해. 그래서 영웅님께선 무슨 일로 왔어? 초: Pretend you didn't hear that. So what brings our hero here? Come to meet a Champion or something?
A hero arrives, and it's nothing special? An obvious lie, but I'll let it slide. What would you like to hear about? Old Valdrick?
I'll tell you about old Valdrick.
strings.싸움에 미쳐 초인이 된 남자, 상처가 있어 흉왕이라 불리는 발드릭 아저씨: Valdrick, the man so obsessed with fighting that he became a Champion, called the Fierce King because of his scars... Whenever he shows up, all of Phobos becomes a racket.
strings.몬스터들을 잡는 건 그렇다 쳐. 꼭 마르스에 들어올 때 한 두 마리 남겨: Hunting monsters is fine. But whenever he comes into Mars, he leaves one or two alive, and those survivors always gather a whole pack and come after him.
strings.뭐, 그래도 나쁜 사람이 아닌 건 알고 있어. 나도, 마르스 시티도, 시: Still, I know he isn't a bad person. He's helped me, Mars City, and the mayor. He saved us from the Deimos cult's attack, shouting, 'Weiss, you bastard!'
strings.여러 소문이 있긴 하지만, 만나서 느끼는 거 아니면 제발 믿지 마. 사람: There are all kinds of rumors, but please don't believe them until you've met him yourself. People believe things they've never experienced. They do it to Veled, too.
Veled isn't bad. Still, he's a demon, so people have to be careful.
strings.어쩌다 보니 벨레드 이야기를 했네. 만약 무슨 일이 있어 포보스에 나간다: Somehow I've ended up talking about Veled. If you need to go out into Phobos, he'll help you.
He's a sweet boy who truly likes humans. Oh! What am I saying...?
strings.아, 시간이 이렇게 됐네? 미안, 영웅님. 나는 좀 바빠. 해야 할 일이: Oh, look at the time! Sorry, hero. I'm busy. There's a lot I have to do.
strings.그러니까…. 다른 게 알고 싶으면 다른 사람한테 물어봐야 할 거야. 적어: So... if you want to know anything else, you'll have to ask someone else. An outsider's view should be more accurate than mine, at least.
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 피오니아가 자신을 찾아온 사람들과 함께 어디론가: (As soon as she finishes speaking, Peonia heads off with the people who came to see her.)
strings.여기도 여기 나름대로 사정이 있나보네…. 그럼 로즈마리에게 인사하러 가볼: This place has its own share of problems... Shall I go say hello to Rosemary?
...I wanted to rest, and now I have to see a familiar face.
Forget it. Come here. Keep me company for a bit. I was bored.
strings.오랜만이에요. 그런데 마르스 시티에 온 지 얼마나 됐어요?: It's been a while. How long have you been in Mars City?
A while. Somehow I ended up going into Avalon, then getting chased out. I thought I'd rest here...
I'd like to return to Freios, but it hasn't worked out. You look curious. What do you want to know?
When I tried asking Peonia about the mayor, she seemed to change the subject.
Really? I don't know the details either, but I'll tell you what I know.
You know the Fierce King? Not because he's vicious; the man who became a Champion through his obsession with combat. They say he visits Phobos every year.
strings.클라우스 시장이 초인과 친해지면 좋을 것 같다 그래서 대련을 했는데, 발: Mayor Klaus thought it would be good to befriend a Champion, so they sparred. Valdrick got excited and went wild. He was having a great time, but the mayor must have felt like he was dying.
Then, when the time for Valdrick's visit came around, Mayor Klaus disappeared.
And a large number of demons appeared in Phobos. More monsters, too...
strings.발드릭이 나타나고, 시장이 사라졌어. 그리고 이 땅을 노리려는 악마와 몬: Valdrick arrives, the mayor disappears, and demons and monsters show up eyeing this land. Surely that isn't all coincidence?
strings.벨레드라는 악마가 좀 신기하긴 하지만, 클라우스 시장이 사라진 것과는 시: That demon Veled is unusual, but the timing doesn't match the mayor's disappearance. He came here much earlier.
strings.피오니아를 보고 반해서 한참 동안 구애를 했는데, 피오니아가 딱 잘라 거: He fell for Peonia at first sight and courted her for ages, but she flatly rejected him.
strings.주민들이 무서워해서 도시에 들어오지 말라고 하니까 여기만 바라보고 있더라: When they told him he couldn't enter the city because he frightened the residents, he just stayed outside looking this way. Said he'd keep waiting...
strings.악마 주제에 순정파야…. 그것도 인큐버스가…. 평소의 나라면 벌써 소멸시: A demon who's a hopeless romantic... And an incubus, at that. Normally I'd have destroyed him already, but Peonia stopped me.
strings.그런데 그 녀석 이상해. 스스로 동족인 다른 악마도 소멸시키고, 시장이: Still, he's odd. He destroys other demons, his own kind, and seems to do whatever the mayor tells him.
strings.발드릭을 찾으면 시장에 대해서 알 수 있을까요?: If I find Valdrick, could I learn something about the mayor?
strings.네 맘대로 해. 피오니아가 발드릭의 오해를 풀어주고 싶다고 했으니 하는: Do what you like. Peonia said she wanted to clear up the misunderstanding about Valdrick, so you might as well do that too.
Both Crisien and Peonia seem to think well of him.
Apparently Valdrick stays in a place called the Cradle every year. Try there.
strings.그리고 피오니아를 대신해 내가 벨레드에게 메시지를 전달하려고 했는데, 귀: And I was going to deliver a message from Peonia to Veled, but I can't be bothered. You do it.
Nothing much. Just say thank you. She said he'd understand.
strings.그러면 요람에 가기 전에 벨레드에게 가볼게요. 로즈마리는 이제 여기서 어: Then I'll see Veled before going to the Cradle. What will you do now, Rosemary?
Me? Get back to work, I suppose. I'm only here for a little while...
I'll contact you separately if I meet any Demigods.
Ugh, what a nuisance. Why do I have to clean up after those people...?
I have found you, my doll.
strings.(벨레드 앞에 어떤 소년의 형상이 나타나 손을 뻗는다. 형상은 형상일 뿐: (The image of a boy appears before Veled and reaches out. It is only an image, and its hand cannot touch him. Still, its voice continues to address Veled.)
We shall meet soon, my doll. Very soon...
strings.(벨레드 앞에 있던 누군가의 형상이 흔적도 없이 사라진다.): (The figure before Veled vanishes without a trace.)
strings.왜 초면인 악마가 나에게 인형이라 부르는 거지? 아름다운 조각이면 몰라도: Why would a demon I've never met call me a doll? A beautiful sculpture, perhaps, but a doll...
Doll or sculpture, why would someone so beautiful as me...
strings.왔어? 난 그냥 있었어. 아, 하나만 물어볼게. 너 말이야. 내가 조각: You're back? Nothing much. Oh, let me ask you something. Do I look like a sculpture or a doll?
strings.조각은 뭐고, 인형은 뭐예요?: What do you mean, a sculpture or a doll?
strings.누가 나한테 인형이라 그러잖아. 세상에 아름다운 인형이 있다한들 나한테: Someone called me a doll. No beautiful doll in the world could compare to me... What was that about?
strings.그런데 무슨 일이야? 나한테 아름다움에 대한 강의를 받고 싶어?: Anyway, what brings you here? Want a lecture on beauty?
I'll pass on the lecture. I'm here with a message from Peonia.
strings.(피오니아라는 말에 시큰둥한 표정의 벨레드의 눈빛이 반짝인다.): (Veled's bored eyes sparkle at the mention of Peonia.)
I came to deliver a message from Peonia.
strings.피오니아가 뭐라고 했는데?! 어서, 어서 말해줘! 내 귓가에 들려달라고!: What did Peonia say?! Quickly, tell me! Let me hear it!
strings.알았어요. 다른 건 없고, 그냥 고맙대요. 그렇게 말하면 벨레드가 알 거: All right. Nothing else, just thank you. She said you'd understand.
strings.%s, 피오니아의 메시지를 전달해줘서 고마워. 내가 뭔가 해주고 싶은데…: %s, thank you for bringing Peonia's message. I'd like to do something for you...
strings.(말을 다 끝내기가 무섭게 알 수 없는 불길한 기운과 뒤섞인 어둠이 포보: (Before the adventurer can finish, darkness mingled with an unknown, ominous energy sweeps into Phobos.)
strings.벨레드, 어떻게 된 건지 알아요?: Veled, do you know what's happening?
Some powerful demon is openly announcing its presence. Maybe it's after something...
strings.(갑자기 벨레드가 가슴을 움켜쥐고 주저앉는다.): (Veled suddenly clutches his chest and sinks to the ground.)
strings.괜찮은 것 같아. 내가 왜 이러지….갑자기 두려워…. 한 번도 이런 적이: I think so. What's wrong with me...? I'm suddenly afraid... This has never happened before...
Not even when a legion commander-level demon appeared. What on earth...? Ah...
strings.(순간 벨레드의 표정이 바뀌었어. 뭔가 떠올린 것 같은데….): (His expression changed for a moment. As though he remembered something...)
You go on ahead. I need some rest. I'm suddenly tired.
strings.아, 맞다. 가서 발드릭이라는 인간의 오해도 좀 풀어줘. 피오니아가 원하: Oh, that's right. Clear up the misunderstanding about that human Valdrick, too. Peonia wants that, so you're better suited to it than a demon like me.
The Cradle where he stays is over that way. And be careful.
You'll understand when you get there.
Thank you, anyway. I'll be going.
strings.(그런데 조심하라는 건 뭐고, 가보면 알 거라는 건 뭐지…?): (But what am I supposed to be careful of? And what will I understand when I get there...?)
strings.(환의 요람이라 생각되는 장소 근처에 다가가려는 순간, 어디선가 거대한: (Just as %s approaches what seems to be the Cradle of Illusions, an immense force comes flying from somewhere.)
strings.(느껴지지 않아. 뭐지? 이 힘은 대체…. 이대로 맞았으면 분명 나는 죽: (I couldn't sense it. What is this power...? If that had hit me, I would definitely have died...)
It was you, just as I thought.
strings.(흙먼지가 사라지고 눈앞에 거대한 몸집의 붉은 머리 사내가 서 있다.): (As the dust clears, a huge red-haired man stands before the adventurer.)
You're Valdrick, right? The Fierce King...
That's right, I'm Valdrick! Ahahaha! Good to meet you! I've heard about you. Or rather, I came to know about you. Either way, good to meet you! Ahahaha!
I don't like formality. Just speak freely.
All right, Valdrick. It's good to meet you too.
strings.(엄청난 악력이다. 살짝 쥔 것 뿐인데 엄청난 힘이 느껴져.): (What an incredible grip. He barely squeezed, but I can feel tremendous strength.)
strings.보통 사람이라면 분명 내 힘을 느끼고 도망갔을 텐데, 잘 버텼어!: An ordinary person would have felt my power and run. You held up well!
strings.내가 널 한 번도 보진 않았지만, 왠지 반갑네? 너도 대충 알고 있지?: I've never seen you before, but somehow it's good to see you. You have some idea why, right? We keep learning things we'd rather not know.
I can't be bothered, so I let them go as soon as they come.
That sounds like a good approach. I came to find you, and here you are.
Peonia's worried about you. She says the residents have the wrong idea.
She's always like that. I tell her to stop nagging, but she keeps at it. And she's always so busy she never rests.
strings.얼마 전엔 귀찮은 악마까지 붙더라. 혼내주려고 했더니 또 건들지는 말라네: Recently, she even picked up a troublesome demon. I was going to teach him a lesson, but she told me not to touch him. She really puts everything into life.
strings.그런데, 여기서 뭐 하세요?: What are you doing here, anyway?
strings.발드릭이 어떻게 한 게 아닐까 생각하는 사람이 있어서 오해를 풀러 왔어요: Some people think you might have done something to him. I came to clear up the misunderstanding.
strings.흐, 그래? 날 무서워하면 그렇게 생각할 수 있어. 오해같은 건 익숙해서: Heh, really? I can see why people who fear me might think that. I'm used to misunderstandings... I'm looking for Klaus myself. I'm sure he's nearby, but I can't find him.
strings.그건 그렇고 너도 느꼈지? 미친 악마의 힘이 이 주위에서 맴돌고 있는 게: Anyway, you felt it too, right? The power of some crazy demon lingering around here... It's probably what's leading all the demons gathering in Phobos.
So, come to the Cradle with me.
strings.스승의 유해가 있는 마을이야. 하지만, 지금은 폐허일 뿐이지만…. 너,: The village where my master's remains were kept. Though it's only ruins now... Can you feel that demon's power ahead?
strings.왠지 모르지만!! 강한 놈이 있을 것 같아!! 클라우스도 찾을 수 있을: I don't know why, but I think there's a strong one in there! And I think we'll find Klaus!
Hahaha, you understand, right? This is what power is for.
strings.좋아! 바로 환의 요람으로 가자고!: Great! Straight to the Cradle of Illusions!
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 발드릭이 환의 요람 안으로 뛰어 들어간다. 엄청나: (Before the words have faded, Valdrick dashes into the Cradle of Illusions. He is far too fast to catch.)
He said we'd go together... Sigh...
strings.(환의 요람의 제일 깊은 곳, 발드릭이 괴기스러운 모습을 한 존재의 공격: (Deep in the Cradle of Illusions, Valdrick gleefully parries the attacks of a grotesque being.)
strings.와, 너 정말 강하네? 지금까지 만났던 악마들과는 달라! 재미있어졌어!: Wow, you're really strong! Different from the demons I've met before! Now this is fun!
A vulgar human obsessed with fighting...
strings.그런 도발에 내가 응할 거라 생각해? 하하하, 그러면 그 기대에 부응해주: You think I'll rise to that provocation? Hahaha, then I'll live up to your expectations. How would Master have taken you down?
strings.근육바보인데 신의 축복을 받은 인간이라 생각이 안 읽혀!! 매혹도 안 통: A musclehead, but blessed by a god, so I can't read his thoughts! My charm doesn't work either! This is infuriating!
What a powerful scent of roses...
strings.고귀하고 아름다운 몽마에게 저거라니…. 아, 그러고 보니 너! 그 인간: 'That'? To a noble, beautiful dream demon...? Ah, you! You're that human. You won't leave this place. I'll destroy you.
Who are you? You sound as though you know me.
strings.나는 릴리스. 네 가슴에 가시를 찔러 장미가 자라게 할 거야. 내 사랑을: I am Lilith. I will drive thorns into your chest and make roses grow there. You killed my love, and I will pass judg—
strings.전투 중에 시끄럽군. 하압!: Too much chatter during a fight. Hah!
strings.(발드릭의 강력한 공격에 거대한 소용돌이가 공간 안을 가득 채운다.): (Valdrick's powerful attack fills the space with an enormous vortex.)
strings.…저기, 발드릭. 혼자 지름길로 가버리고 길 모르는 제가 몬스터와 악마들: ...Valdrick. You took a shortcut on your own, while I, who didn't know the way, had to deal with every monster and demon!
strings.하하하, 미안, 미안. 내가 나중에 밥 사줄게. 프리링 카레면 되겠어?: Hahaha, sorry, sorry. I'll buy you a meal later. Priring curry sound good? Hey, you! Watch out!
strings.(자욱한 먼지 속에서 뭔가가 반짝거리며 날아온다. 찰나의 순간, 발드릭이: (Something flashes through the thick dust. In an instant, Valdrick rushes in front of %s.)
strings.싸움에만 미친 인간인줄 알았더니 인정이란 것도 있나 봐?: I thought you were only a battle-crazed human. So you have some compassion after all?
strings.초인이라 불리는 존재들은 이 녀석한테 내적 친분이란게 있거든. 처음 봐도: We Champions feel a kind of inner friendship with this one. Like we're close even when meeting for the first time.
strings.너…, 고귀한 악마라면서 치사하게 싸우네. 한 방에 안 죽을까봐, 하나인: You... For a supposedly noble demon, you fight dirty. Afraid one wouldn't kill, so you threw dozens disguised as one...
This hurts quite a bit. First time since that bastard Weiss got me...
Valdrick, are you all right? That wound...
strings.(발드릭의 배에 거대한 가시가 박혀 있다.): (An enormous thorn is embedded in Valdrick's abdomen.)
strings.당연히 괜찮지 않지. 꼬맹이와 달라 죽을 수도 있지만, 그래도 죽지 않으: Of course I'm not all right. Unlike the little one, I can die, but I'm not going to. Don't panic. Just deal with this quickly.
I'm sorry. But by the little one, do you mean...
strings.그럴 시간에 저 몽마에게 한 번이라도 더 공격해. 잠깐 치료하고 있을 테: Spend that time landing another blow on that dream demon. I'll patch myself up. Just wait. Hah!
strings.(발드릭이 기합을 외치자 배에 박혀 있던 가시가 떨어진다. 상처 사이로: (Valdrick shouts, and the thorn lodged in his abdomen falls out. Blood continues to pour from the wound.)
strings.멍청한 인간…. 금방이라도 죽을 것 같은 표정으로 허세나 부리고…. 뭐,: Stupid human... Bragging when you look ready to die at any moment... Well, never mind.
Lord Degos. The time has come. I will kill the human who made you disappear.
strings.내가 사랑한 격노의 화신. 그는 정말 아름다웠어. 그 아름다움에 빠져 내: The incarnation of rage whom I loved. He was so beautiful. I fell for that beauty and abandoned even Asmodea to follow him, and you killed him.
strings.아름다운 그가 없는 세계는 정말 괴로웠어. 아스모데아는 내가 자기를 따르: A world without his beauty was unbearable. And Asmodea did this to my body because I wouldn't follow him.
strings.사랑하는 남자의 모습이 되라면서!! 아름다운 날 이렇게 괴물의 모습으로: He told me to take the form of the man I loved! Turning my beautiful self into this monster...
strings.많은 몽마의 사랑을 받으면서 내가 자기를 사랑하지 않는다고 시기를 하다니: Beloved by so many dream demons, yet jealous because I wouldn't love him... Well, I am beautiful.
strings.난 문이 열리자마자 널 만나기 위해 로젠가르텐을 넘어서 왔어. 널 쓰러뜨: As soon as the gate opened, I came through Rosengarten to find you. If I defeat you, Asmodea will acknowledge me.
strings.(저 몽마, 잘못 알고 있네. 데고스는 소멸하지 않았어. 분명 다시 돌아: (She's mistaken. Degos wasn't destroyed. He clearly said he'd return. Hasn't she heard?)
You must see my beauty properly. Only then will Lord Degos...
strings.(오해하든 말든 상관없어. 어차피 내 앞에 있는 적….): (Whether she's mistaken doesn't matter. She's an enemy standing in my way...)
strings.릴리스, 너 말이야. 데고스와 한 편이라면 당연히 내가 어떤 사람인지 알: Lilith. If you were on Degos's side, you must know what sort of person I am.
Good. I'll do to you what I've done to everyone who tried to harm living beings.
strings.(그 말과 함께 붉게 타오르고 있던 릴리스의 눈빛이 어둠의 기운으로 가득: (At those words, darkness fills Lilith's burning red eyes.)
strings.기대할게. 난 적어도 데고스 님처럼 되지 않을 테니까!!: I look forward to it. At least I won't end up like Lord Degos!
I... I can't defeat this human... Lord Degos...
I'll grant that you're as strong as Degos.
strings.하지만, 나에게 너나 데고스나 똑같은 악마일 뿐이야. 이 세계에 해를 끼: But to me, you and Degos are just the same: demons who threaten this world.
Don't think we're the same! I am a pure demon. He was a human who became a demon...
strings.데고스를 사랑했다면서 출신 성분을 나누고, 그처럼 되지 않기를 바라고 있: You claim you loved Degos, yet you draw distinctions over his origins and hope not to share his fate. A demon full of contradictions, talking about love...
strings.사랑한다는 건 헛소리야?: Was all that talk of love nonsense?
My love isn't a lie. No, more than that, there's something strange about you...
What's strange about me? Answer my question.
strings.몽마가 말하는 사랑이라는 게 정말일까? 가진 능력 때문에 착각하는 건 아: Is the love dream demons speak of real? Or do your own abilities make you mistake it for love?
strings.(단 일격이면 끝나는데, 나는 왜 망설이고 있지?): (One strike would finish this. Why am I hesitating?)
strings.(뭔가를 알아차린 릴리스의 표정이 변한다. 아름다운 몽마가 아닌 정말 지: (Lilith's expression changes as she realizes something. She looks less like a beautiful dream demon than a monster from the deepest pit of hell.)
strings.(하지만, 그것도 잠시. 어디선가 뜨겁고 거대한 힘이 릴리스를 향해 날아: (But only for a moment. An immense, searing force flies toward Lilith from somewhere.)
That's right. Valdrick, the Fierce King.
strings.(발드릭이 환한 표정으로 다가와 %s의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Valdrick approaches with a bright expression and pats %s on the shoulder.)
strings.아, 그런 거군. 그러면 마무리는 나한테 맡겨. 이런 건 너보다 나에게: Oh, I see. Then leave the finishing blow to me. This suits me better than you.
What was your name, anyway? Come to think of it, I never asked.
strings.(%s의 이름을 듣자 발드릭이 미소를 짓는다. 그 미소와 함께 릴리스가: (Valdrick smiles upon hearing %s's name. At that smile, Lilith seems to sense something and begins to tremble.)
strings.너 릴리? 릴리스? 아, 귀찮아. 그래, 너 악마, 내 질문에 제대로 대: You, Lili? Lilith? Ah, who cares. You, demon. Answer my question properly, and I'll think about it.
strings.클라우스를 봤어? 키가 나 정도 되고 멋진 미소가 인상적인 남자야. 40: Have you seen Klaus? A man about my height, with a strikingly handsome smile. Early to mid-forties, blond hair, blue eyes.
Th-that man. He went th-there. R-Rosengarten...
strings.마계? 인간이 어떻게 마계로 가?: The Demon Realm? How does a human go there?
strings.그, 그게 로젠가르텐하고 포보스의 어떤 곳하고 연결됐어. 더는 몰라. 모: W-well, Rosengarten has connected to somewhere in Phobos. I don't know any more. I don't! Is that enough? P-please spare me...
strings.%s, 내가 이 악마한테 볼일이 있어서 조금만 기다려. 잠깐 눈 감고 있: %s, I have some business with this demon. Wait a moment. Close your eyes for a bit.
strings.(발드릭에게서 엄청난 광기가 느껴져…. 일단 하자는 대로 해야겠어.): (There's such madness coming from Valdrick... I'd better do as he says.)
strings.%s…, 착한 녀석이네. 너 릴리 어쩌고…. 아, 그냥 악마. 사람들이: %s... Good kid. You, Lili-whatever... Ah, just demon. Do you know why people call me the Fierce King?
strings.그, 그걸 내가 어떻게 알아?! 하찮은 인간 이명을?!: H-how would I know some insignificant human's title?!
A noble demon would have no interest in an insignificant human. Of course you wouldn't know.
Then I'll teach you. I am the one who makes even demons tremble...
strings.세상 모든 흉악함의 왕이니까!!!!!!: Because I am the king of all the world's savagery!
strings.(발드릭의 광기어린 목소리가 사라지면서 거대한 힘이 %s 양 옆으로 빠른: (As Valdrick's crazed voice falls silent, immense power races past both sides of %s.)
strings.릴리스가 사라졌어. 아니, 소멸했어. 비명조차 지르지 못하고…. 발드릭이: Lilith's gone. No, she's been annihilated. She didn't even scream... It looked like Valdrick only gathered his power and struck once...
strings.(흙먼지를 뒤집어쓴 발드릭이 어디선가 뛰어올라 %s 앞에 착지한다.): (Covered in dust, Valdrick leaps out from somewhere and lands before %s.)
Let's get out first. We'll talk outside.
...That was less of a rampage than you might think.
strings.여기가 스승의 고향이라 적당히 한 것 뿐이야. 시간 나는 대로 복구하고: This is my master's hometown, so I held back. I've been restoring it whenever I have time. Don't worry too much.
I've got plenty of time, as long as I don't die.
strings.좋은 사람이었지. 그러고 보니 너무 오래됐다. 마지막까지 약한 사람들을: A good person. It's been so long now. She helped the weak until the very end. Then she died.
strings.복수하고 싶었는데, 스승이 원치 않았을 거야. 스승 죽인 놈도 알아서 늙: I wanted revenge, but Master wouldn't have wanted it. Whoever killed her probably grew old and died on their own.
strings.아쉬운 건 내가 스승가는 마지막을 보지 못한 거야. 죽었다는 소식만 듣고: What hurts is that I wasn't there at the end. By the time I heard she was dead and returned, only a memorial tablet remained in the shrine. They said her ashes had been scattered somewhere in Debora overlooking the sea...
strings.나중에 '진'이라는 나라 출신 사람들 만나면 물어봐. '환'이라는 여성: If you meet anyone from a country called Jin, ask them. They'll tell you what a female martial artist named Hwan means to them.
I see. From the name alone, I thought your master was a man.
strings.그렇지? 나도 처음엔 그런 줄 알았지. 아, 이제 스승 이야기는 이쯤 하: Right? I thought so at first, too. Ah, enough about Master.
strings.너도 클라우스가 로젠가르텐이란 곳에 갔단 걸 들었지?: You heard that Klaus went to a place called Rosengarten, right?
Yes. It's connected to somewhere in Phobos...
I'll have to look for it.
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 발드릭이 포보스 어딘가를 향해 뛰어간다. 엄청나게: (Before the adventurer can respond, Valdrick races off into Phobos, far too fast to follow.)
I was going to suggest asking Veled. He said he was from Rosengarten...
strings.다른 사람 말은 좀처럼 안 들리나 보네. 어쩔 수 없지. 혼자 가는 수밖: He really doesn't listen to other people. Nothing for it. I'll have to go alone...
strings.(그런데, 나 또 그런 모습이었어. 내가 아닌 것 같은 나…. 발드릭,: (But I was like that again. A version of me that doesn't feel like me... Valdrick noticed. Even the demon did.)
strings.(벨레드가 있던 방향에서 알 수 없는 기운이 느껴져….): (I can feel a strange energy from where Veled was...)
Whew. I don't know. Let's see Veled first.
strings.(벨레드가 일그러진 표정을 지으며 한쪽 눈을 가리고 있다.): (Veled covers one eye, his face contorted.)
strings.(이건 악마의 힘이다. 데고스와 말파스를 만났을 때와 비슷한…. 그런데: (This is demonic power. Like when I met Degos and Malphas... But I didn't feel it at first.)
strings.미안해. 내가 지금 이럴 수밖에 없어. 그러니까 다가오지 마!! 겨, 겨: I'm sorry. I can't help being like this right now. So stay away! I'm b-barely holding on!
strings.빨리 로젠가르텐으로 가!! 네가 로젠가르텐으로 가기만 하면 난 어느 정도: Go to Rosengarten, quickly! Once you go there, I can hold on a little longer. I have to!
strings.(벨레드의 절규와 함께 그의 눈에서 피가 흐르기 시작한다.): (As Veled cries out, blood begins to run from his eyes.)
R-Rosengarten is connected to an old well the people of Phobos used. There are rose vines and fallen petals, so y-you'll find it easily...
strings.가서 이 목걸이에 달린 장식을 가져다 줘. 그렇지 않으면…. 내 손으로: Go and bring me the ornament that belongs on this necklace. Otherwise... I might kill Peonia with my own hands...
I am me. He says he's my master... But I... I...
strings.(벨레드가 말을 다 하지도 못한 채 몸이 굳어가고 있다. ): (Before Veled can finish, his body begins to stiffen.)
strings.그냥 내버려둘 걸 그랬나. 여기 있는 인간들의 영혼을 가져오게…. 어차: Perhaps I should have left him alone. Let him bring me the souls of the humans here... He'll return eventually anyway...
strings.(어디선가 벨레드와 비슷한 목소리가 들려온다.): (A voice resembling Veled's comes from somewhere.)
strings.(이건 분명…. 포보스에 오기 전에 봤던 그 자의 목소리….): (That's definitely... the voice of the one I saw before coming to Phobos...)
What a noisy doll. There was no need to explain things to a mere human.
strings.거기 인간에게 내가 보이는군. 그때 날 지켜보고 있었느냐? 마계의 영역을: So that human can see me. Were you the one watching me then? Daring to peer into the Demon Realm...
strings.버릇 없는 인간이네. 먼저 네 소개를 하는 것이 예의다. 뭐, 됐다. 이: What an ill-mannered human. Courtesy demands that you introduce yourself first. No matter. I already know.
strings.나는 로젠가르텐의 주인이자 몽마들의 지배자 '아스모데아'. 릴리스를 만났: I am Asmodea, master of Rosengarten and ruler of the dream demons. If you met Lilith, you must know my name.
strings.역시 힘이 있는 자가 있는 영역에 릴리스를 두길 잘 했네. 어느 정도 힘: It was wise to place Lilith where someone powerful was nearby. She let me see how much strength you possess.
So Lilith wasn't there of her own free will.
strings.그녀는 어차피 몽마. 몽마의 지배자인 내가 건 매혹에 걸렸을 뿐이다. 그: She was a dream demon, after all. She merely fell under the charm of her ruler. Naturally, she believed she went of her own accord.
strings.일반적인 인간이라면 벌써 내 매혹에 빠져 영혼을 바치러 왔을텐데, 아무렇: An ordinary human would already be under my charm, coming to offer their soul. Yet you are unaffected... Fascinating. Enough to stir even my heart...
strings.(아스모데아가 미소를 지으며 손을 뻗는다. 손 끝에서 장미 한 송이가 피: (Asmodea smiles and extends a hand. A single rose blooms at his fingertips.)
I formally invite you to Rosengarten.
strings.(이 짙은 장미 향…. 저쪽이군….): (That rich scent of roses... It's coming from that way...)
Come to me. And offer me your soul.
strings.네가 오지 않는다면 지금보다 많은 수의 악마와 몬스터들이 포보스로 향할: If you do not come, even more demons and monsters will march into Phobos.
strings.그건 원하지 않겠지?: You would not want that, would you?
I take that as a compliment. The Demon Realm's way of thinking differs from yours.
strings.나는 기대할 것이고, 기다리고 있을 것이다. 강한 힘을 가진 괜찮은 영혼: I shall wait, with anticipation. Finding a fine soul with great power is a stroke of fortune even for a demon.
strings.(아스모데아가 다시 한 번 미소를 짓자 손 안에 있던 장미가 재로 변한다: (Asmodea smiles again, and the rose in his hand turns to ash. A breeze scatters it, and his form disappears.)
An elaborate way to issue an invitation.
strings.…이럴 때 내가 다 해결할 거라는 실바리아 황제 폐하의 예언이라도 들었다: ...At a time like this, a prophecy from the Empress of Silvaria saying I'd resolve everything would be reassuring...
strings.(어두운 공간 사이에서 밝은 빛이 들어온다.): (Bright light spills through the dark space.)
strings.정말 현실에서는 볼 수 없을 정도로 아름다워. 아름다운 햇살에 장미가 가: It's so beautiful it hardly seems real. A garden full of roses in lovely sunlight...
strings.여기가 마계군. 이제 와, 아우님?: So this is the Demon Realm. Just getting here, little sibling?
strings.어우, 깜짝이야. 발드릭, 언제 왔어요?: Whoa, you startled me! Valdrick, when did you arrive?
Just now. I finally found it. What a strong scent of roses...
strings.같이 생사에 관련된 일을 하니 이미 형제라도 해도 되겠지. 난 성별 상관: We've faced life and death together. That makes us family already. I call everyone my little sibling, regardless of gender.
I get the feeling you'd keep calling me that even if I asked you not to.
Little sibling Ziskad gave up, too. Though he made up for it by drinking a tremendous amount...
Ahahaha! Don't worry about things like that, little sibling.
strings.(분명 잊었다. 아, 신경 쓰여….): (He definitely forgot. Oh, that's bothering me...)
strings.그러면 아우님. 이야기 해봐. 클라우스 말고 다른 목적으로 온 것 같은데: So, little sibling. Tell me what's going on. It seems you came here for more than Klaus...
strings.(발드릭에게 벨레드에게 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (The adventurer tells Valdrick what happened to Veled.)
I see. Things have gotten complicated.
What will you do, Valdrick? The path splits in two...
strings.아우님도 비슷한 생각 했지?: You had the same thought, didn't you?
strings.내가 왼쪽으로 갈테니, 아우님으로 오른쪽으로 가. 아, 가다가 클라우스를: I'll go left, you go right. Oh, if you find Klaus, stay with him.
But I don't know what Mayor Klaus looks like.
strings.붉은색 머리에 파란 눈동자, 키는 나 정도하고, 하여튼 잘 생겼어. 무슨: Red hair, blue eyes, about my height, and handsome. When there's trouble, he wears armor with gold chains. You'll recognize him easily.
All right. I'll look for him along the way.
You too, Valdrick. Huh? You used my name. And he's already gone.
strings.(장미 정원의 막다른 골목, 그 앞에서 아스모데아가 고급스러워 보이는 테: (At a dead end in the rose garden, Asmodea sits before an elegant table.)
strings.잠깐 기다리거라. 티타임이 막 시작됐으니 조금만 즐긴 후에 이야기를 나누: Wait a moment. Tea has just begun. Let me enjoy it a little before we speak.
You invite a guest, then keep them waiting.
strings.아, 손님? 내가 널 초대했었나? 그렇다면 내 기꺼이 너에게도 한 잔 내: Oh, a guest? Did I invite you? Then I shall gladly pour you a cup as well.
strings.(아스모데아가 빈 찻잔에 차를 따라 내민다.): (Asmodea fills an empty teacup and offers it.)
Who knows what's in that tea...
strings.영혼의 찌꺼기를 양분 삼아 뿌리를 내리고 자란 장미, 그 첫 번째 잎에: Roses rooted in the remnants of souls, nourished by them... Their first petals are touched by the hands of a beautiful succubus.
Drink tea brewed from those petals, and you will wish to remain in Rosengarten.
A prized specialty that even other demons long to taste.
There's something I want to know.
I heard Mayor Klaus came here.
strings.클라우스? 그 자가 클라우스인가? 인간의 이름 따위 기억할 필요는 없지만: Klaus? Was that his name? I have no need to remember human names, but it sounds familiar.
strings.꽤 괜찮은 영혼이었지, 허나 나보단 아인호른 같이 욕심많은 마수가 삼키기: Quite a fine soul, though better suited to be swallowed by a greedy demonic beast like Einhorn than by me.
strings.그래도 대답을 듣고 싶다면 아인호른에게 가서 말을 걸거라. 어쩌면 마수의: If you still want an answer, go and speak to Einhorn. Perhaps the man's voice will emerge from the beast's mouth...
Perhaps your brother has already destroyed it...
strings.탐욕이란 건 크고 끝이 없이 자란다. 그 시장이라는 인간도 크게 벗어나지: Greed grows vast and endless. That human mayor was no exception. That is why he set foot in Rosengarten.
strings.바이스의 심부름꾼과 좋은 계약을 했나 보군. 그 인간은 자신의 소원을 위: He seems to have struck a fine bargain with Weiss's messenger. To have his wish granted, he offered generous terms. Every living being in Phobos and Mars...
Weiss again... And why would Mayor Klaus...
strings.클라우스? 그 인간은 그런 인물이었다. 생명의 힘으로 잔뜩 만들어진 데이: Klaus? That was the sort of man he was. Worth less than the Deimos cult's magic stones, packed with the power of living beings...
strings.넌 그 마석으로 뭘 하려는 거지? 마석으로 만든 인형을 왜 원하는 거지?: What are you trying to do with those stones? Why do you want a doll made from magic stones?
You clearly called Veled a doll.
strings.(순간 아스모데아의 표정이 어두워진다. 미소를 지으며 여유를 보여주던 느: (Asmodea's expression darkens. His smile and easy composure vanish.)
strings.(밝은 빛이 가득했던 로젠가르텐이 어두워지고, 아스모데아의 위로 악마처럼: (The bright light of Rosengarten dims, and a demonlike being appears above Asmodea.)
strings.오래 전 어떤 생명이 따르던 뒤틀린 자가 있었지. '포보스'라 한다. 이: Long ago, there was a Twisted One whom certain beings followed. Phobos, it was called. This is a part of him. My friend, a demon god, will fight you beside me.
strings.내 인형과 함께 내 결핍을 채워줄 양분이 되어다오. 여신의 심부름꾼이여…: Together with my doll, become the nourishment that fills my emptiness. Messenger of the goddess... Hehehe.
strings.(짧은 정적이 지나고, 아스모데아의 입에서 피가 조금씩 흘러내린다.): (After a brief silence, blood begins to trickle from Asmodea's mouth.)
strings.마신 '포보스'가 소멸하다니…. 비록 일부긴 해도 데이모스의 쌍둥이 형제: The demon god Phobos, destroyed... Even if it was only a fragment, Phobos is Deimos's twin...
strings.결핍과 힘이라고 했던 걸 보면 네 영혼은 불완전했나 보군. 인형과 나로: From your talk of emptiness and power, your soul must have been incomplete. You meant to fill it with the doll and me...
Cough, cough... I will not deny it.
There is little to tell... Cough, cough.
I merely agreed to answer his summons.
strings.(악마 소환의 대가는 마석인가?): (Were magic stones the price for summoning demons?)
A demon who wants magic stones made by gathering life force...
strings.네 힘에 문제가 생긴 거군. 그래서 다른 방식으로 힘을 채워야 하는 거고: Something went wrong with your power. So you have to replenish it another way.
You look as though you hate to admit it.
In the Demon Realm, a weak demon is immediately devoured. To survive...
strings.살기 위해서 어쩔 수 없어서 그래서 거래를 했다?: You had no choice if you wanted to survive, so you made a deal?
strings.나는 이대로 쓰러질 수 없다. 결핍을 채우고, 로젠가르텐을 넘어 판데모니: I cannot fall here. I will fill my emptiness, reach beyond Rosengarten to Pandemonium... And that bastard Degos, and Lux...
strings.(아스모데아의 발악에 로젠가르텐이 흔들린다. 그리고 얼핏 포보스와 마르스: (Rosengarten shakes at Asmodea's desperate struggle. An opening forms, offering glimpses of Phobos and Mars City.)
strings.로젠가르텐이여. 아름다움을 포기해도 좋다. 포보스를 삼켜라!! 포보스의: Rosengarten! You may surrender your beauty! Devour Phobos! Swallow every soul in Phobos and bring them to me!
strings.(아스모데아의 말과 함께 로젠가르텐의 장미들이 갑자기 시들어버린다. 그리: (At Asmodea's words, the roses of Rosengarten suddenly wither, then rot and release a strange odor.)
strings.로젠가르텐이 아름다움을 버리는 것은 참을 수 없지만, 그래도 내 결핍이: I cannot bear for Rosengarten to lose its beauty, but if only it will fill my emptiness!
Ugh... M-my body... You, a doll made from my power and magic stones, dare...
strings.(아스모데아, 네가 날 망가뜨릴 수 있다는 건 나도 널 그렇게 할 수 있: (Asmodea. If you can destroy me, that means I can do the same to you...)
strings.벨레드? 로젠가르텐에 전체에 들려오는 것 같은데, 뭐지?: Veled? His voice seems to be echoing all over Rosengarten. What's happening?
Weiss, I will never forgive you...
strings.(온 몸이 굳어 움직일 수 없던 아스모데아의 손끝에서 갑자기 불길이 피어: (Flames suddenly rise from the fingertips of Asmodea, whose entire body has stiffened.)
strings.(잠시 후, 아름다운 악마는 재가 되어 바람에 흩어지고 만다. 그리고 그: (A moment later, the beautiful demon turns to ash and scatters on the wind. A single rose-shaped pendant drops beneath him.)
strings.이건 벨레드가 원했던 물건인가? 그러면 이곳의 일은 다 끝난 거겠지?: Is this what Veled wanted? Then everything here is finished, right?
strings.후우…. 일단 발드릭을 찾아서…. 어?: Whew... First, I should find Valdrick... Huh?
strings.알고 있을지 모르겠지만, 영감 밑에 있었던 바랄이라고 한다. 그나저나 정: You may know me. I'm Baral, who served under the old man. The Spirit King's medicine works well, I see. Judging by how stupidly you stood there.
Baral? Urgh... When did you attack...?
I attacked four times, and you didn't notice a single one.
(As he finishes speaking, the hook wound around Baral's hand flies toward %s. An enormous shock wave easily knocks it away.)
Rest for a bit, little sibling.
strings.(윽, 발드릭의 한 마디에 일어날 수가 없어….): (Ugh. Just a word from Valdrick, and I can't get up...)
The most troublesome human of all has arrived.
strings.바이스도 그렇지만, 초인은 쓸데없는 정보를 정말 많이 알게 된다니까. 신: Weiss is the same. Champions learn so much useless information. Divine power... No wonder everyone wants to become one.
strings.바랄, 날 죽이고 클라우스를 초인으로 만들려 했지? 아니, 클라우스를 미: Baral, you meant to kill me and make Klaus a Champion, didn't you? Or were you using Klaus as bait to kill me?
That's right. Spending time with the old man has made you fairly perceptive.
strings.아스모데아의 마수가 잡아먹은 걸 멍청한 네가 박살냈어. 거기에 애송이까지: Asmodea's beast ate him, and you, idiot, smashed that beast to pieces. Then the whelp got involved, too. Very entertaining.
I'm not keen on listening to Weiss, but that's enough for now. I'm leaving, fool.
strings.멈추라고 하면 내가 가만히 있을 것 같아? 답답한 놈…. 귀찮지만, 특별: You think I'll stay just because you tell me to stop? What a hopeless fool... A nuisance, but I'll give you one special piece of information.
strings.지금 이대로 있으면 시공간의 틈으로 네놈들 다 빨려 들어갈걸? 그럼 나: Stay here, and you'll all get sucked into a rift in spacetime. Now I'm really leaving. If you want to see me again, meet me in Avalon.
strings.(바랄이 등을 돌리자마자 그의 모습이 환영처럼 사라진다.): (The moment Baral turns his back, his figure disappears like an illusion.)
strings.(바랄이라는 저 사람…. 바이스와 비슷한 느낌이야. 그리고 아발론에서 보: (That man, Baral... He feels like Weiss. And he said to meet him in Avalon. What is that black hole...?)
strings.감탄하고 있을 때가 아냐, 아우님. 이 검은 구멍은 악마가 만든 게 아냐: This isn't the time to admire it, little sibling. That black hole wasn't made by a demon. It's a tear in spacetime. It's growing, so we need to leave now.
strings.아우님, 손에 쥔 빨간 장미 장식 있잖아. 피오니아 따라다니는 악마 꼬맹: Little sibling, that red rose ornament in your hand. You're giving it to the little demon who follows Peonia around, right?
Yes. Veled asked me to bring it.
strings.(발드릭이 한 손으로 모험가를 들어 어깨에 올린다.): (Valdrick lifts the adventurer with one hand and sets them on his shoulder.)
strings.(발드릭이 씨익 웃더니 눈 앞에 보이는 검은 구멍을 향해 미친 듯이 달려: (Valdrick grins, then charges madly toward the black hole ahead.)
strings.(피오니아가 굳은 상태로 서 있는 벨레드를 쓸쓸히 바라본다.): (Peonia looks sadly at Veled, who stands frozen.)
strings.왜 아무 말이 없어? 왜 그렇게 서 있는 거야?: Why aren't you saying anything? Why are you standing like that?
strings.마르스 시티 앞을 서성이던 악마들이 사라져서 벨레드에게 무슨 일이 생긴: The demons lingering outside Mars City disappeared, so I came to see if something had happened to you...
I'm sorry I let this happen... It's my fault. I should have paid closer attention...
Uncle Valdrick? %s? Why are you here...?
Peonia, it's been a while. My little sibling had something to deliver to Veled.
When you've faced life and death together, you're practically family.
strings.말해줘, %s. 발드릭 아저씨와 함께 있는 거라면 보통 일이 아니겠지?: Tell me, %s. If you're with Uncle Valdrick, it must be something serious.
strings.(피오니아에게 포보스에서 있었던 일을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (The adventurer briefly tells Peonia what happened in Phobos.)
strings.시장님이 사라지신 건 그런 이유였구나. 뭔가 있다고만 생각했는데, 하지만: So that's why the mayor disappeared. I thought something was going on, but when I found this on his desk and heard your story, %s...
Yes. The Deimos cult's magic stones...
strings.마르스 시티의 주민들을 대신해서 고맙다는 말을 하고 싶어. 발드릭 아저씨: On behalf of everyone in Mars City, thank you. And thank you too, Uncle Valdrick.
strings.시장님의 일은 내가 제대로 수습할게. 주민들을 설득하는 게 좀 힘들지도: I'll handle the aftermath of the mayor's actions properly. Convincing the residents may be difficult... But I'll make sure they understand you weren't responsible, Uncle Valdrick.
He's the one who saved me.
Here, Veled. I brought the red rose pendant, as promised.
strings.(%s의 손 끝에서 펜던트가 떠올라 벨레드에게 향한다. 펜던트가 그의 가: (The pendant rises from %s's fingertips and floats toward Veled. The moment it touches his chest, something restraining him shatters.)
strings.(멈춰있던 시간이 다시 흐르는 것처럼 벨레드의 눈동자가 움직이기 시작한다: (Veled's eyes begin to move, as though frozen time has resumed.)
strings.정말 괜찮아? 내가 보여?: Are you really all right? Can you see me?
Yes, I'm all right. And thank you. I heard everything...
strings.돼, 됐어. 그러니까 정말 괜찮은 거지?: N-never mind that. So you're really all right?
strings.응. 괜찮아. 이제 난 악마가 아닌 걸까? 원래부터 아닌 건가? 그래도: Yes. I'm fine. Am I no longer a demon? Was I never one to begin with? But still, a demon...
strings.정말 괜찮은 거지?: You're really all right, aren't you?
strings.(벨레드의 시선이 모험가와 발드릭을 향한다.): (Veled looks toward the adventurer and Valdrick.)
All right. You must have something to tell them. Then I'll...
All right... I'll go back to Mars, then.
And Uncle Valdrick. I'll make you something delicious, so you have to come. I'm sorry.
strings.미안하긴…. 됐다. 네가 그런 것도 아닌데…. 하하하. 그럼 조심해서 가: Sorry? Forget it. You didn't do anything... Hahaha. Get back safely.
strings.(발드릭이 피오니아가 사라질 때까지 손을 흔든다. 어느 정도 피오니아의: (Valdrick waves until Peonia is gone. Once she is well out of sight, Veled approaches quietly.)
You two. There's somewhere I need you to come with me.
I just have something to show you. You too, Valdrick.
I doubt I need to see it, but I'll come along.
strings.(벨레드가 발드릭과 %s의 손을 붙잡는 순간, 시야에 담긴 풍경이 변한다: (The moment Veled takes Valdrick and %s by the hand, the scenery changes.)
A doll made from magic stones in my image. With this, I should be able to make myself whole.
strings.(아스모데아 앞에 벨레드와 비슷한 모습의 존재가 있다.): (A being resembling Veled stands before Asmodea.)
strings.너는 내가 될테니, 친히 이름을 지어주마. 벨레드, 그래. 넌 벨레드가: You will become me, so I shall name you myself. Veled. Yes, Veled will suit you. The name of the great one who founded Rosengarten.
I dislike it, but if I am to stand against those who covet Rosengarten, I have no choice.
strings.악마들에게도 영혼이 있다는 건 처음 알았다. 그리고 영혼에도 결핍이 있다: I never knew demons had souls. Nor that those souls could be incomplete.
Trembling with fear that other demons might discover it... How amusing.
Opening a rift in spacetime to enter Rosengarten... I commend you.
strings.궁금한게 있다. 너는 아가슈라의 수장에 버금가는 힘과 고대신이 남긴 힘을: I am curious. You possess power rivaling the leader of the Agasuras, as well as power left by the ancient gods. How did that happen?
Things simply... turned out that way. Perhaps I have even surpassed those pursuing me...
strings.재미있는 남자로다. 어쨌든 마계를 점령하고, 네 소환에만 응해주면 되는: What an interesting man. In any case, I need only conquer the Demon Realm and answer your summons?
strings.데이모스를 강림시키려는 너, 그의 형제 '포보스'의 일부를 가지고 있는: You, seeking to bring Deimos into this world, and I, holding a part of his brother Phobos. This meeting cannot be coincidence.
It is what he desires. And what I desire as well.
Let us say our aims differ, but share enough in common.
strings.마지막으로 한 마디 하지. 마석으로 만든 네 인형이 다른 곳에서 깨어나지: One last word. I hope your doll made from magic stones does not awaken somewhere else.
strings.이 땅의 생명이 가진 영혼의 힘은 강하다. 그렇게 만들어진 마석으로 또: The souls of this land's living beings hold great power. You made something else from stones formed with that power, and mixed another power into it...
Something beyond your expectations could happen.
strings.그 이야길 들으니 궁금하군. 하지만, 이곳이 아닌 다른 곳에서 벨레드가: That makes me curious. But Veled will never awaken anywhere outside this place.
Has he gone? A human speaking like a demon. How interesting.
Now I shall wait for my doll to awaken. And...
I will never send him anywhere else.
strings.(더 이상 아스모데아와 그가 있던 로젠가르텐이 보이지 않는다.): (Asmodea and Rosengarten are no longer visible.)
strings.내 기억의 일부는 아스모데아의 것이더라고. 그러니까 아스모데아가 전혀 보: Some of my memories belonged to Asmodea. That's why Asmodea himself never appeared in them.
Now I'm neither a doll nor a demon. But I'm not human, either.
I'm all right for now, but I don't think I will be after a while.
strings.검은 구멍 때문에 이곳에 떨어졌고, 처음 본 인간 피오니아를 보고 어떻게: I fell here through a black hole. Peonia was the first human I saw, and now I want to understand how I came to love her...
strings.나 피오니아 앞에 제대로 서고 싶어. 어쩌면 방법이 있을지도 몰라!: I want to stand before Peonia properly. Maybe there's a way!
I don't quite understand, but you're a fine fellow. I'd like to call you my little sibling.
strings.피오니아에게 이야기 잘해줄게. 봐서 알지? 피오니아는 그래도 내 말 잘: I'll put in a good word with Peonia. You've seen it, right? She listens to me pretty well.
Tempting, but I still don't want to call you big brother.
strings.그냥 내가 부르는 것뿐인데?: I'm only saying I'll call you that.
strings.그래, 벨레드 아우님. 특별한 동생이 생기는 것만큼 기분 좋은 일도 없으: Good, little sibling Veled. There's nothing quite like gaining a special younger sibling. Right, little sibling %s?
strings.이젠 안 아프지?: It doesn't hurt anymore, does it?
Oh, now that you mention it...
strings.내가 널 위해서 별거 아니지만 힘을 나눠서 주입했다. 이거라면 새로운 신: It's nothing much, but I shared some of my power and put it into you. That should help the girl who became a new god.
strings.가, 감사합니다, 발드릭! 이, 이리스가 기뻐할 거예요!: Th-thank you, Valdrick! I-Iris will be delighted!
strings.여신님…이라 불러야겠지? 여신님께서 좀 더 힘을 갖추시면 바이스 놈도 때: Goddess... I should call her that, shouldn't I? Once she regains more power, I trust she'll help us beat that bastard Weiss.
Until then, I'll keep getting stronger. I still haven't had my revenge on him.
strings.뭐, 덕분에 내가 살아갈 목표가 생긴 거지만…. 아, 난 조금 쉬고 바랄: Well, thanks to him, I've got something to live for... Oh, I'll rest a little, then go looking for Baral.
strings.돌아가면 지스카드 아우님에게 전해줘. 내가 시켰다고 하면 별말 안할 거야: Tell little sibling Ziskad when you return. Say I told you to, and he won't argue.
strings.그리고 당분간은 스승의 마을에서 지내고 있을 거니까 대련이 하고 싶으면: I'll be staying in my master's village for a while. Come find me if you want to spar. I'm not what I used to be, but I can manage three days and nights!
strings.벨레드. 발드릭. 그러면 저 가볼게요. 저를 이곳으로 보낸 분께 잘 해결: Veled. Valdrick. I'll be going now. I should tell the person who sent me here that everything worked out.
strings.가이아 님이시군…. 이번엔 어떤 모습이시지? 200년 전, 게르다에서 한: Lady Gaia... What form is she taking this time? I met her once in Gerda two hundred years ago. I was surprised because she looked like my master.
strings.그런데 다시 잠드실 시간이 아니신가? 아닌가? 뭐, 잘 계시겠지. 만나면: But isn't it time for her to sleep again? Or not? Well, I'm sure she's fine. Give her my regards.
Yes. %s, tell old Atkina I said thank you.
strings.(용의 계곡에 가기 전에 미뉴에트를 잠깐 보러 가볼까? 어쩌면 가이아 님: (Should I stop by Minuet before going to Dragon Valley? Maybe I can see Lady Gaia again...)
strings.(벨레드가 환하게 웃으며 %s의 모습이 포보스에서 사라질때까지 손을 흔든: (Veled smiles brightly and waves until %s disappears from Phobos.)
strings.피오니아에게 뭐라고 이야기해줄 거야?: What will you tell Peonia about me?
strings.포보스를 지키는 멋진 놈?: That you're a fine fellow who protects Phobos?
strings.혹시 가이아 님께 무슨 일이라도 생긴 걸까?: Could something have happened to Lady Gaia?
strings.(아드키나 님에게 물어보자…. 설마 무슨 일 있는 건 아니겠지?): (I'll ask Lord Atkina... Surely nothing's wrong?)
strings.그대가 뭘 염려하고 있는지도 알고 있네. 가이아 님은 때가 되어서 다른: I know what concerns you. The time came, and Lady Gaia went elsewhere.
strings.잠이 드실 시기가 얼마 남지 않았음을 깨달으시어 '맹약의 성소'로 향하셨: Realizing that little time remained before her sleep, she headed for the Sanctum of the Covenant.
strings.신탁을 받은 이들이 신에게 맹세하는 성스러운 장소…, 어디에 있는지는 잘: A sacred place where those who receive divine revelations swear an oath to a god... I don't know where it is, but it will appear before you when the time comes.
strings.(왠지 금방 갈 수 있을 것 같은데….): (Somehow, I feel I'll get there soon...)
strings.아, 그러면 미뉴에트는 어떻게 되는 건가요?: Oh, then what will happen to Minuet?
Minuet is fine. She's simply asleep, as usual.
Whew. I thought something had happened.
I can see why you would. Hahaha.
strings.아, 벨레드 일은 고맙네. 난 그가 그대를 도와줄 거란 생각만 했지, 다: Oh, thank you for helping Veled. I only thought he would help you. Nothing else occurred to me.
Oh, that just happened along the way...
Perhaps I learned more because Valdrick was with you.
Now I will be setting out.
I will travel beyond Adrica and trace Weiss's movements across the continent.
strings.아드키나 님, 그러면 환수들과 아드리카는요?: Lord Atkina, what about the spirit beasts and Adrica?
strings.당분간 메디아가 지켜봐주기로 했네. 환수들의 먹이는 샤이닉이 루맨에서 잔: Medea has agreed to watch over them for a while. Shynic said she would buy plenty of food in Lumen and feed the beasts enough to keep them alive.
The land has been purified enough to admit those it judges righteous. Ziskad and Miss Io have also promised help if anything happens, so it should be fine for now.
strings.하지만, 바이스가 데이모스 강림을 준비하고 있는 걸 알게 된 이상, 나는: But now that I know Weiss is preparing to bring Deimos into this world, I must stand and fight, as I did before.
strings.세레스 님과 가이아 님께서 구원해주신 고대 플루톤 드래곤의 목숨. 이제는: This ancient Pluton Dragon's life was saved by Lady Seres and Lady Gaia. Now it is time to repay them.
strings.괜찮네. 가이아 님께는 허락을 받았네. 이 땅을 지켜달라고 명하신 그분께: It's all right. I have Lady Gaia's permission. Though leaving might seem disrespectful to the one who commanded me to protect this land...
We cannot let you bear the fate of this world alone.
strings.오늘은 여기서 쉬었다 가게. 그대를 위해서 준비한 것들이 많네. 환수들도: Rest here today before you leave. I've prepared much for you. The spirit beasts will be delighted, too.
Then I'll gladly stay and rest. I was just getting hungry...
strings.와, 파티다! 파티! 먹을 거다!: Wow, a party! A party! Food!
strings.어, 미르가 왜 거기서 나와요?: Huh? Mir, why are you coming out of there?
Ahaha... It's time for me to get moving.
If Mir has come... then perhaps...
strings.사실은 모험가님을 찾아 어디까지 가야 하는지 고민했었는데 마침 여기라서: I was wondering how far I'd have to go to find the adventurer. It's a relief you happened to be here.
strings.(미르가 품 안에서 편지를 하나 꺼내 %s에게 전달한다.): (Mir takes a letter from inside his clothes and hands it to %s.)
A decree from Her Majesty, the Empress of Silvaria...
Please open it in front of Lord Atkina at the exact time written here.
strings.(저번하고 비슷한 상황이네…. 이미 예지된 상황….): (This is like last time... A situation that was already foreseen...)
strings.네, 그럴게요. 저기 아드키나 님. 그때까지 신세를 질 수 있을까요?: All right. Lord Atkina, may I stay with you until then?
strings.나는 언제라도 괜찮으니 그대 편한대로 하게. 오늘은 아무 생각하지 말고: I don't mind whenever it is. Stay as long as you like. Today, put everything out of your mind and enjoy yourself. Lady Gaia would want that too.
strings.감사드려요. 그럼 저 잠깐 용의 계곡을 산책하고 와도 될까요? 생각할 게: Thank you. Then may I take a short walk through Dragon Valley? I have something to think about...
strings.그러게. 그대가 돌아올 쯤엔 인간도 환수도 좋아하는 그런 음식이 만들어져: Of course. By the time you return, we'll have food ready that humans and spirit beasts alike will enjoy.
strings.(모험가가 잠시 자리를 비우는 사이 미르가 아드키나를 조용히 바라본다.): (While the adventurer steps away, Mir looks quietly at Atkina.)
Mir, the adventurer will be all right. Must be all right.
strings.만약 그를 불행하게 만드는 자가 있다면 대지를 비롯한 달과 꽃, 초목의: If anyone brings the adventurer sorrow, the mistress of the earth, moon, flowers, and growing things will not stand idle. Nor will I.
